_comment: DBS Bank Ltd — FY2025 (year ended December 31, 2025)
_source: DBS Annual Report 2025 (dbs.com), The Singaporean Investor FY2025 summary, The Asian Banker
_note_balance_sheet: Total Assets est. SGD 800B; Net Loans SGD 445B (55.6%); Total Deposits SGD 610B (76.3%). Loans grew 6% (constant currency), deposits 12% — record inflow. LDR 72.9%. Over two-thirds of deposits in CASA. Largest bank in Southeast Asia.
_note_deposits: Over two-thirds CASA (~72%). Singapore's high savings culture drives large savings deposits. Current ~20%, Savings ~52%, Term ~28%. DBS is dominant in Singapore institutional and retail deposits.
_note_exposure: Institutional Banking (large corporate, trade finance, real estate) ~40%, Consumer Banking (Singapore mortgages ~25%, personal/wealth ~15%) + SME ~15%. Strong in trade finance and wealth management across Asia.
_note_credit_quality: NPL ratio 1.0% (stable, non-performing assets declined 4%). Resilient through Asia credit cycles. Highly secured book with strong collateral coverage.
_note_pnl: NIM 2.01% (-12bps YoY as Singapore rates eased). Total income SGD 22.9B (+3%). Net profit SGD 11.0B (record). ROA 1.28%. ROE 16.2%. Cost-income 40% (best-in-class for global banks).
_note_capital: CET1 17.0% — highest among Singapore's major banks and well above MAS requirements. Strong internal capital generation supports CET1 well above regulatory floors.
